identities.name: ConnectionId
identities.proposition: Identifies one established physical or logical protocol connection occurrence.
identities.lifetime: Never reused while any session or output obligation still names it.

identities.name: CurrentnessToken
identities.proposition: Carries opaque evidence that a subject is current according to its owning authority.
identities.scope: One exact subject and authority generation.
identities.equality: Opaque equality through the owner; never structural or locally derived.
identities.lifetime: Valid only while the owner confirms the exact subject remains current.

identities.name: DeadlineId
identities.proposition: Identifies one bounded time obligation.
identities.lifetime: Settled once by completion, cancellation, or timeout.

identities.name: FailureId
identities.proposition: Identifies one bounded failure occurrence without redefining its semantic cause.
identities.owner: Owning boundary that observed the failure.
identities.lifetime: Retained only as required for causal evidence and cleanup.

identities.name: IngressSequence
identities.proposition: Orders observed message occurrences at one ingress authority.
identities.equality: Integer order is meaningful only within its owning ingress stream.
identities.lifetime: Never moves backward or crosses connection scope.

identities.name: LifecycleTransitionId
identities.proposition: Identifies one attempted or committed protocol lifecycle transition.
identities.lifetime: Retained through the transition receipt and session cleanup.

identities.name: MessageId
identities.proposition: Identifies one exact observed message occurrence.
identities.equality: Exact per occurrence; repeated equal bytes remain different messages.
identities.lifetime: Never reused within a session.

identities.name: MutationBarrierId
identities.proposition: Identifies one ordering barrier for state-changing work.
identities.lifetime: Remains valid until all work ordered behind it observes settlement.

identities.name: OperationId
identities.proposition: Identifies one semantic application operation requested by a route.
identities.lifetime: May outlive one work occurrence but not its owning request cleanup.

identities.name: OutputId
identities.proposition: Identifies one prepared or admitted writer obligation.
identities.lifetime: Lives until delivery fate and cleanup are known.

identities.name: OutputSequence
identities.proposition: Orders output obligations at one writer authority.
identities.equality: Integer order is meaningful only within its owning writer stream.
identities.lifetime: Never moves backward or crosses writer scope.

identities.name: ProgressKey
identities.proposition: Identifies one progress stream independent from request identity.
identities.equality: Distinct from request and reverse-request domains even when raw values resemble.
identities.lifetime: Released only after progress completion or owning session cleanup.

identities.name: PublicationId
identities.proposition: Identifies one committed causal publication proposition.
identities.lifetime: Never reused; rejection creates no committed publication identity.

identities.name: RequestKey
identities.proposition: Identifies one JSON-RPC request obligation using an exact numeric or string variant.
identities.equality: Numeric and string variants are distinct; equality is exact inside one scope.
identities.lifetime: The same raw variant may be reused only after exact cleanup; another connection or session is another key.

identities.name: ReservationId
identities.proposition: Identifies one capacity and accounting obligation.
identities.lifetime: Released exactly once after every owner completes or transfers its obligation.

identities.name: ReverseRequestKey
identities.proposition: Identifies one server-originated request awaiting a client response.
identities.equality: Distinct from client request and progress identity domains.
identities.lifetime: Released only after response, cancellation, connection loss, or explicit timeout settlement.

identities.name: RouteId
identities.proposition: Identifies the selected protocol-to-application route.
identities.equality: Exact route identity, independent from operation and work occurrence.
identities.lifetime: Stable for the request after selection.

identities.name: SessionId
identities.proposition: Identifies one lifecycle and runtime incarnation on a connection.
identities.lifetime: A new incarnation receives a new value even on the same connection.

identities.name: TaskId
identities.proposition: Identifies one runtime task occurrence.
identities.lifetime: Lives through join, cancellation, or failure settlement.

identities.name: WorkId
identities.proposition: Identifies one concrete queued or running work occurrence.
identities.lifetime: Never reused while the work or its cleanup remains unsettled.
